notes.text: Logan Mailloux is out long term and has not played this season. He is a top-four defenseman. Adam Jiříček has taken his spot beside Philip Broberg.
They dressed 11 forwards and 7 defensemen last game. Fedor Svechkov takes shifts on two lines, L3 and L4. Noah Juulsen is the seventh defenseman, rotating in mostly beside Kulak and Toews.

COL.head: The Avalanche should be favored
COL.body: Colorado has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage, while St. Louis is on the second night of a back-to-back. If the Blues want to spoil it, start with keeping dangerous shots away.

STL.head: The Blues are up against it
STL.body: Colorado has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage, while St. Louis is on the second night of a back-to-back. To pull this off, the Blues can start with keeping dangerous shots away, plus a goalie who steals the show.
